title: Veterans Pension Care-Cost Adjustments — Raising the Spouse's Social Security Figure
content:
# Spouse's Social Security in a care-cost rate adjustment — Veterans Pension

Where the Veterans Pension rate category counts spouse income, the spouse's Social Security figure used in a care-cost rate adjustment is raised by the age of its benefit level: the whole months from the date the benefit level took effect, as shown on the most recently received spouse income report, to the date of the adjustment.

- A spouse Social Security figure whose benefit level took effect 24 or more whole months before the adjustment is raised by the two most recent December cost-of-living increases together: multiplied by 1.0537.
- One that took effect 12 to 23 whole months before is raised by the most recent December increase: multiplied by 1.028.
- One under 12 whole months old is used as reported: multiplied by 1.

The raised figure is rounded to the cent.

### Example schedule (hypothetical spouse figure 9000.00)

| Age of the benefit level | Spouse's income used |
|---|---|
| 11 whole months | 9000.00 |
| 12 whole months | 9252.00 |
| 23 whole months | 9252.00 |
| 24 whole months | 9483.30 |
